hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,re,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);L=[x.strip() for x in (d.get('last_assistant_message') or '').splitlines() if x.strip()];p=next((x for x in L[::-1] if not re.match(r'([-*+]|\d+[.)]|\(\w\))\s',x)),L[-1] if L else '');q=re.search(r'？|\?(\s|\Z)|(ください|下さい|ますか|ですか|でしょうか|ませんか)([。．.!！]|\Z)',p) or re.search(r'(?i)\b(should i|shall i|do you want|would you like|let me know)\b',p);sys.exit(10 if d.get('background_tasks') else 11 if q else 12 if d.get('stop_hook_active') else 13)"; s=$?; [ $s -eq 10 ] && exit 0; r=1; [ $s -eq 13 ] && r=2; echo 'trace-gate: check を走らせた(結果は標準エラー)'; python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/tools/trace_gate.py check --root "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >&2; c=$?; [ $c -eq 0 ] && exit 0; exit $r
